# Temple Scroll Column 23 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** 11Q19 (Cave 11), Col. 23 | **Condition:** well preserved

---

**23:1** You shall offer upon it your burnt offerings and your peace offerings, your tithes and your voluntary offerings, and all your choicest votive offerings that you vow to Me.

**23:2** You shall eat there before Me with joy — you and your households, your sons and your daughters, your male and female servants, and the Levite who resides within your gates, for he has no allotment or inheritance among you.

**23:3** Guard yourself against offering your burnt offerings in any place you happen to see. Only in the place that I choose within one of your tribes shall you offer your burnt offerings.

**23:4** There you shall carry out all that I command you: your burnt offerings and your sacrifices, your tithes and your voluntary offerings, and all the choicest of your vows that you vow to Me.

**23:5** You shall not offer upon it any unauthorized incense, nor any burnt offering or grain offering not prescribed; nor shall you pour upon it any unsanctioned drink offering.

**23:6** You shall sacrifice the peace offerings, and you shall eat there and rejoice before Me at your appointed festivals.

**23:7** You shall present upon the altar the daily burnt offering: a yearling lamb without blemish in the morning, and the second lamb you shall present at twilight.

**23:8** With it, a tenth-measure of fine flour mixed with a quarter-hin of beaten oil, and a drink offering of a quarter-hin of wine — a fire-offering, a pleasing aroma to Me, the LORD.

**23:9** On the Sabbath day: two yearling lambs without blemish, together with two tenth-measures of fine flour mixed with oil as a grain offering, and its accompanying drink offering.

**23:10** This is the Sabbath burnt offering, each Sabbath, in addition to the daily burnt offering and its drink offering.

**23:11** You shall make atonement upon the horns of the altar once each year. With the blood of the sin offering of atonement, once each year the priest shall make atonement upon it.

**23:12** Throughout your generations, it shall be most holy to Me, the LORD.

**23:13** At the beginning of each month, you shall present a burnt offering to Me: two young bulls from the herd, one ram, and seven yearling lambs without blemish.

**23:14** Three tenth-measures of fine flour mixed with oil as a grain offering for each bull, two tenth-measures of fine flour mixed with oil as a grain offering for the ram.

**23:15** And a tenth-measure of fine flour mixed with oil as a grain offering for each lamb — a burnt offering, a fire-offering, a pleasing aroma to Me, the LORD.

**23:16** Their drink offerings shall be: half a hin for each bull, a third of a hin for the ram, and a quarter of a hin for each lamb, of wine. This is the new-moon burnt offering, month by month, throughout the months of the year.

---

*LOGOS notes: Column 23 well preserved. Sacrificial calendar draws heavily on Numbers 28-29. "At twilight" used for bein ha-arbayim (standard scholarly rendering). "Yearling" for ben shanah. "New-moon" specified for the monthly offering context.*
